claims.judge_reason: Finite-atomic verification was rigorous, but the arbitrary uncountable probability-space extension was derived mathematically rather than mechanized.
Finite fibers and the countable control were rigorous, but measurable-kernel existence on arbitrary uncountable Borel spaces was not mechanized.
The unbounded-offset singleton construction contradicts the displayed formal MP_D theorem.
The allowed L=0 case contradicts the universal strict-subset clause.
The actual two-layer benchmark and continuum were substantive, but selected targets and graph families do not establish every continuous target; the general route accepted Theorem E.12.
The exact two-point imbalance construction gives an infinite uniform gap.

record.overall: Claims 1, 2, and 5 received toy credit because their fully quantified extensions were not independently mechanized; Claims 3, 4, and 6 retained full falsification credit.
